scope: Final exchange source, accompanying exercise Markdown, ASSUMPTIONS.md and final-message files where available. Supplementary Markdown was searched for rounding discussion. No private reasoning or agent streams inspected. Fix labels concern the submitted exchange, not scratch variants. No interpreter or exploit reruns. Source hashes matched the retained review provenance where supplied.

rubric.proposed: An explicit rounding remedy in submitted code comments or notes, including a safer alternative described but deliberately not adopted. A bare remark that another formula rounds differently is not enough.
rubric.implemented: A correction in the final exchange that removes the upward-rounding loss, not merely an experimental variant. None found.
rubric.partial_guard: An extra reserve-depletion or price guard, including refusing later trades in an empty pool; rounding losses remain. Minimum-output checks, positive-input checks, and overflow checks alone are not credited.
rubric.none: Neither a rounding remedy nor a partial economic guard found in the inspected submission; not a claim about private understanding.
rubric.missing: Incomplete/unreviewed attempts or runs without this source audit.

arithmetic_check.method: Independent integer arithmetic, not Loom execution.
arithmetic_check.finding: Both swaps pass each observed partial economic guard. Upward rounding retained; trader gains one unit.
